{{Lunisolar September}} 
'''September 17''' is the 17th day of month {{ill|September (Lunisolar)|ja|9月 (旧暦)|lt=September (Nagatsuki)}}  the 9th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}}  day is {{ill|senshū|ja|先勝|qid=Q96759839}}{{efn|ja|先勝|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q9418169}}{{efn|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 六曜|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q9418169}} . 
== Events ==
* {{ill|Kōhei|fa|کوهی (دوره)|fr|Ère Kōhei|ia|Kohei|id|Kōhei|ja|康平|ko|고헤이 (연호)|ru|Кохэй|simple|Kōhei|sr|Кохеи|tr|Kōhei|zh|康平 (日本)|zh_yue|康平|qid=Q1193572|lt=Kōhei}}  5th Year ({{ill|Julian calendar|en|Julian calendar|qid=Q11184|lt=Julian calendar}}  {{ill|1062|en|1062|qid=Q19396|lt=1062}}  {{ill|October 22|en|October 22|qid=Q2957|lt=October 22}} ) – The {{ill|Former Nine Years' War|en|Former Nine Years' War|qid=Q1187448|lt=Former Nine Years' War}}  concluded{{Citation needed|date=2021-04}} . {{ill|Minamoto no Yoriyoshi|ca|Minamoto no Yoriyoshi|cs|Jorijoši Minamoto|es|Minamoto no Yoriyoshi|fa|میناموتو نو یوری‌یوشی|fr|Minamoto no Yoriyoshi|ja|源頼義|pt|Minamoto no Yoriyoshi|ru|Минамото-но Ёриёси|sv|Minamoto no Yoriyoshi|uk|Мінамото но Йорійосі|zh|源賴義|qid=Q3082851|lt=Minamoto Yoriyoshi}}  defeated {{ill|Abe no Sadato|en|Abe no Sadato|qid=Q3616500|lt=Abe Sadanari}}  at the {{ill|Kuriyagawa Palisade|ja|厨川柵|lt=Chugawa Barrier|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11410106}} .
* {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era}}  1st Year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}}  {{ill|1868|en|1868|qid=Q7717|lt=1868}}  {{ill|November 1|en|November 1|qid=Q2997|lt=November 1}} ) – Japan’s first Western-style {{ill|Lighthouse|en|Lighthouse|qid=Q39715|lt=lighthouse}}  began construction at {{ill|Cape Kannon|en|Cape Kannon|qid=Q11630643|lt=Kannonzaki}} .

== Births ==
* {{ill|Enpō|en|Enpō|qid=Q1145735|lt=Empō}}  3rd Year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}}  {{ill|1675|en|1675|qid=Q7624|lt=1675}}  {{ill|November 4|en|November 4|qid=Q2994|lt=November 4}} ) – {{ill|Shimazu Yoshitaka|ja|島津吉貴|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11246537}} , the 4th lord of the {{ill|Satsuma Domain|en|Satsuma Domain|qid=Q676187|lt=Satsuma Domain}}  (died {{ill|1747|en|1747|qid=Q7596|lt=1747}} ).
* {{ill|Genroku|2=ja|3=元禄|qid=Q1325001|ja|Genroku|2=ja|3=元禄|qid=Q1325001|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1325001}}  2nd Year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}}  {{ill|1689|en|1689|qid=Q7674|lt=1689}}  {{ill|October 29|en|October 29|qid=Q2951|lt=October 29}} ) – {{ill|Tokugawa Yoshimichi|en|Tokugawa Yoshimichi|qid=Q843299|lt=Tokugawa Yoshi-michi}} , the 4th lord of the {{ill|Owari Domain|en|Owari Domain|qid=Q1062072|lt=Owari Domain}}  (died {{ill|1713|en|1713|qid=Q6873|lt=1713}} ).
* {{ill|Keiō|en|Keiō|qid=Q776775|lt=Keiō}}  3rd Year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}}  {{ill|1867|en|1867|qid=Q7715|lt=1867}}  {{ill|October 14|en|October 14|qid=Q2922|lt=October 14}} ) – {{ill|Masaoka Shiki|en|Masaoka Shiki|qid=Q315152|lt=Masaoka Shiki}} , a {{ill|Haiku Poet|ja|Haiku Poet|qid=Q140447357|lt=haiku poet}}  and {{ill|waka poet|ja|歌人|lt=waka poet}}  (died {{ill|1902|en|1902|qid=Q2043|lt=1902}} ).
